title: Daniel and his friends at the king's court in Babylon
description: After Nebuchadnezzar has conquered Jerusalem, Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael and Azariah are chosen among young men from Israel for training at the court in Babylon. They receive new names – Belteshazzar, Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego. Daniel refuses to defile himself with the king's food and wine, and asks to be given vegetables and water for ten days. After the trial period they look healthier and stronger than the others. God gives the four knowledge and insight, and Daniel receives understanding of visions and dreams. The king finds them ten times more capable than all the magicians in the kingdom.
